title: Wall Mount Shower Basket 18.75-Inch Solid Brass Wire, Oval Combination | Antique Bronze | Allied Brass
short_title: Wall Mount Shower Basket 18.75-Inch | Allied Brass, Antique Bronze
description:
Add organized storage to your shower with this wall mount oval combination shower basket crafted from solid brass and ventilated wire for drainage in Antique Bronze, which combines deep brown tones with subtle warm highlights, offering heritage appeal with modern durability. Designed for traditional bathroom hardware looks, it helps keep bottles and soap within reach while saving space.

Highlights:
- Antique Bronze brings rich depth and character
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean, finished look
- Available in a wide variety of designer finish options, including statement colors
- Limited Lifetime Warranty

Specs:
- Category: Basket
- Style: Traditional
- Mounting: Wall mount
- Dimensions: 18.75-Inch L x 4.13-Inch W x 2.25-Inch H (Projection: 4.13-Inch)
- Weight: 4.8 lb
- Included: Basket and all installation hardware
- Assembly required: No
